title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the motional EMF using the formula E = Blv, obtaining 0.80 V.

title: Induced current magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly applies Ohm's Law (I = E/R) to find the induced current, obtaining 4.0 A.

title: Ampere force calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the magnetic force on the rod using F = BIl, obtaining 0.80 N.

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes that for constant velocity, the external force must balance the magnetic force (Newton's first law).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows proper unit analysis throughout the solution (V, A, N).

title: Direction consideration
description: Optional: Mentions or correctly determines the direction of induced current or force using Lenz's law/Fleming's rules.

title: Incorrect EMF formula
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula for motional EMF (e.g., Faraday's law with area change instead of Blv).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in force direction or incorrectly applies equilibrium (e.g., adds forces instead of balancing).

title: Unit conversion mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes errors in unit conversions (e.g., cm/m, mT/T) leading to incorrect numerical results.
